about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a full-stack developer passionate about learning and solving problems, with one foot in software development and the other in hardware technical support. I'm actively working my way into Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Computer Vision, and I enjoy both leading teams and learning from them. I run Linux with Hyprland as my main setup, plus Ubuntu and Fedora on other machines, without leaving Windows behind when the job calls for it.
